utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — I’ve got the small roof leak and loose front gate for this Saturday around 10 AM. I’ll double-check the details and let you know if I need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I’ll keep an eye out for your update and be ready to help sort the tools and donations on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — I’ll confirm the final list and get back to you if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Gus

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — what’s the date and time for the repair drive, and what kind of repairs should we plan for?

utterances.speaker: Gus

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Oren — can you check your list and tell me exactly what tools are still missing?

utterances.speaker: Oren

utterances.speaker: Mina

utterances.speaker: Leo

utterances.speaker: Mara

utterances.speaker: Leo

utterances.speaker: Sam

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s perfect, Sam — thank you. I’ll be ready to help coordinate once your list comes in.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Vik — if you can lay out the timing and what’s being hauled, I can figure out the space we’ll need.

utterances.speaker: Vik

utterances.speaker: Opal

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds good — I think the community hall is the main stop for me. I can help with the list and reach out to a few neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, I’ve got the community hall as the main stop. If you get more locations from neighbors, send them my way and I’ll add them to the list.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the community hall on Maple Street noted for the repair drive. If you have the next location, I can add that too.

utterances.speaker: Uli

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, I’ve got Maple Street down for now. I’ll keep it simple and note anything else as it comes up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ve sorted the repair list and I’m checking who still needs to be contacted now. I’ll let you know what’s left to reach out about.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Mara — that helps. Let me know who still needs contacting, and I’ll jump in where I can.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m on it — I’ll send you the remaining names as soon as I finish checking, and you can jump in from there.

utterances.speaker: Dane

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Perfect—let’s fix the faucet first, then we can move on to the porch step and the lamps.

utterances.speaker: Dane

utterances.speaker: Dane

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re short on screws, painter’s tape, and a couple extension cords. If you can grab those, I’ll have the rest lined up when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m going to stop by the repair drive later and ask what they still need. If I hear the timing or what’s being hauled, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, thanks—I'd appreciate that. I’ve only been hearing bits and pieces, so I’m glad you’re checking on it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure — I’ll stop by later and ask what they still need, then I’ll tell you the timing and what’s being hauled.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 4 to 6 works well for me, and I can help coordinate around pickup and drop-off. If you’ve got the first repair job in mind, I’ll line things up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect — I’ll bring the tool kit and start with the squeaky gate by the side entrance. See you at 4!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I’ll make sure folks know to come after pickup and I’ll keep the timing tight. See you at 4!

utterances.speaker: Quinn

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help sort the screws and nails into small boxes, as long as it stays simple and quiet.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — can you also tell me what you still need most for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli

utterances.speaker: Ira

utterances.speaker: Nell

utterances.speaker: Bo

utterances.speaker: Cleo

utterances.speaker: Bo

utterances.speaker: Oren

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Oren — that helps. If you can confirm the tools and screws, I’ll line up the boxes and figure out where everything can go.

utterances.speaker: Oren

utterances.speaker: Kira

utterances.speaker: Leo

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, so it’s mostly the donated tools and missing hardware — got it. You’ll check for any gaps when you get there, right?

utterances.speaker: Sam

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, you’re a lifesaver, Sam — I’ll bring the list over in a bit, and we can get everything set up together.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Tess — I’ll stay here and keep things organized until you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple: we start with the leaky faucet, then the porch step, and finish by checking the lamps.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 4 to 6 still works for me, and I’ll help line up the school pickup crowd around that plan.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, that plan works for me. I’ll start with the faucet at 4 and keep the rest in order.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
